meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: Claude 会当编排者，把计划按阶段派给子代理执行，并要求交证据（跑过的命令、输出、改动文件）；每阶段后另派子代理做验证、反模式检查和代码质量审查，验证通过才提交代码。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或落实一份计划时触发，尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.text: 按这份计划执行，每个阶段派子代理做，并跑验证清单
say.note: 先派实现子代理，再派验证子代理

say.text: 上一阶段验证通过后，继续执行下一阶段
say.note: 通过后才派提交子代理

say.text: 检查这段改动有没有计划里列出的反模式
say.note: 会派反模式子代理做检索

howto.what_en: Claude orchestrates: subagents execute each phase of the plan and report evidence (commands, outputs, files changed). After each phase it runs verification and anti-pattern and code-quality checks; commits only if verified.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to execute, run or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Run this plan: dispatch subagents per phase and use the verification checklist
Start the next phase once the previous one passes verification
say_en.note: Commit subagent only after it passes

say_en.text: Check these changes for anti-patterns listed in the plan
